content.short: Holograph provides multichain tools for Web3 builders enabling cross-chain asset beaming.
content.description: Holograph enables cross-chain transfers of digital assets while preserving data integrity through its Holographic Bridging process. This approach keeps asset state consistent across participating networks, mitigating cross-chain drift and enabling reliable interoperability. By unifying liquidity and connecting diverse blockchains, Holograph helps streamline cross-chain interactions within the Web3 ecosystem, supporting developers and users across Ethereum, Avalanche, Polygon, Solana, Arbitrum, Multichain, Polkadot, Moonbeam, and BNB Chain.
